# DevTaskHub

> DevTaskHub is a full-stack web and mobile development studio based in Thessaloniki, Greece. It builds websites, e-shops, web apps, iOS and Android apps, AI chatbots and SEO for businesses across Greece and abroad. Languages served: Greek, English, French.

## About
- Name: DevTaskHub
- Location: Thessaloniki (Θεσσαλονίκη), Central Macedonia, Greece
- Serves: All of Greece and the EU, remotely
- Email: info@devtaskhub.com
- Phone: +30 697 198 2563
- How it works: free quote and timeline first, design before code, progress shown at every step, support after launch.

## Services
- [Website & Web App Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/web-development): Responsive, fast, SEO-ready websites and web applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps, published on the App Store and Google Play.
- [E-commerce Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ecommerce-development): Online stores and booking platforms with online payments.
- [Chatbots & AI Agents](https://devtaskhub.com/services/chatbots-ai-agents): AI chatbots and agents for customer support and automation.
- [AI Integration](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ai-integration-applications): AI and machine learning inside applications.
- [SEO & Website Optimization](https://devtaskhub.com/services/seo-website-optimization): Technical SEO, performance and organic growth.
- [Social Media Management](https://devtaskhub.com/services/social-media-management): Strategy and day to day management of social profiles.
- [UX/UI Design](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ux-ui-design): User-centered interface design.
- [Database & Cloud Infrastructure](https://devtaskhub.com/services/database-cloud-infrastructure): Scalable, secure data and cloud architecture.
- [Video & Animation Production](https://devtaskhub.com/services/video-animation-production): Promotional video and motion graphics.
- [Game Development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/game-development): Interactive games for web and mobile.

## Selected Work
Full list: https://devtaskhub.com/portfolio

### Mobile apps
- [LifeMuseum](https://lifemuseumapp.com/): iOS and Android app that turns the moments of your life into museum exhibits and your year into a film. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lifemuseum/id6799032000), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lifemuseum.app).
- [T-Parking](https://t-parking.com/): The first app in Greece that shows free on-street parking spots in real time. Free, iOS and Android.
- [GetFit SKG](https://getfitskg.com/): Gym app for members, training programs, bookings and payments.

### Web apps and platforms
- [Hournook](https://www.hournook.com/): Online booking SaaS for professionals. A booking page in minutes, in 15 languages.
- [Lumora Predictions](https://lumorapredictions.com/): Prediction web app (tarot, coffee cup, crystal ball) with accounts, online payments and an admin panel.
- [Leonidion Houses](https://www.leonidionhouses.com/): Booking platform for 6 properties with online payments and an admin panel.

### Websites
- [KLINARITI](https://klinariti.com/): Personal brand website for an astrologer and clinical psychologist.
- [LifeMuseum website](https://lifemuseumapp.com/): Official app website in six languages.
- [Advanced Derma](https://advanced-derma.com/): Dermatology clinic in Athens and Piraeus, with online appointments.
- [Online Parent & Teen Clinic](https://onlineparentteenclinic.com/): Telemedicine platform with online appointments.
- HANDSTUFF: E-shop for handmade leather bags.
